description: One line at session start pointing statistics, econometrics and risk requests to the econometrics skill, for listings so crowded that Claude Code shows the skill by name only.

hooks.command: echo 'Note from the econometrics plugin: requests that test, estimate or judge numbers (statistics, hypothesis tests, regression, the effect of a promotion or policy, forecasts, VaR or risk) are handled by the skill econometrics:econometrics. Load it before answering, even if the skill list shows only its name. Ignore this note for anything else.'
